A fortnight ahead of the retention deadline, Mumbai Indians and Punjab Kings have all but locked the deal for swapping Hardik Pandya and Arshdeep Singh ahead of Indian Premier League 2027. How did the move materialise and how will it affect these two and other IPL franchises ahead of the IPL Auction on December 16. The Hindu's Amol Karhadkar and Shayan Acharya (Sportstar ) discuss it in detail
Thank you for watching our video!
